title: Initialize Centrality Scores
description: Set betweenness centrality C_B(v) = 0 for all nodes v. These will accumulate contributions from each source node in the graph.

title: For Each Source Node: BFS/SSSP
description: For each node s as source: run Breadth-First Search (unweighted) or Dijkstra (weighted) to compute shortest paths from s to all other nodes. Track distances and predecessor lists.

title: Count Shortest Paths (Forward Pass)
description: During BFS, compute σ[v] = number of shortest paths from source s to each node v. For source: σ[s] = 1. For other nodes: σ[v] = sum of σ[u] for all predecessors u with dist[u] + 1 = dist[v].

title: Stack Nodes by Distance
description: Push nodes onto a stack in order of non-decreasing distance from s (BFS order). This ensures that in the back-propagation phase, nodes farthest from s are processed first.

title: Accumulate Dependencies (Backward Pass)
description: Process nodes from stack (farthest to closest). For each node w: δ[w] = sum over v where w is predecessor of (σ[w]/σ[v]) × (1 + δ[v]). Then add δ[w] to C_B[w] (unless w is the source).

title: Normalize Scores (Optional)
description: For undirected graphs: divide all scores by 2 (each pair counted twice). For normalization: divide by (n-1)(n-2) for directed, or (n-1)(n-2)/2 for undirected, to get values in [0,1].
